elements.label: Whole Claude Design workspace (chat panel plus phone prototype canvas) shrinking from the chat close-up to the wide view

sfx_review.label: unsure
sfx_review.note: 592 ms before the pull-out, at the very edge of the spectrogram; the surrounding audio is regular broadband music hits and nothing visual happens at that moment, but the onset shape is cut off.

pattern.description: Reverse push-in: the camera pulls out from the close-up of Claude's finished answer to reveal the whole workspace, with the generated meditation-app prototype in an iOS frame beside the chat and the Tweaks panel at the right.
pattern.why_premium: The reveal pays off the prompt: you read 'I've built a serene meditation app' and the pull-out immediately shows the built app, cause and result in one continuous move with no cut.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo('.workspace', {scale: 2.1, xPercent: 20, yPercent: -6}, {scale: 1, xPercent: 0, yPercent: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power3.inOut'}).
build_hint.remotion: const p = interpolate(frame, [0, 10], [0, 1], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); scale = 2.1 - 1.1 * p; translateX = 20 * (1 - p) + '%'; or spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 30, stiffness: 120}}) for a no-overshoot settle.

notes: Taxonomy has no pull-out pattern; ui_camera_push_in is used for its reverse (camera.move = pull_out, scale 0.48). The phone prototype has no candidate box of its own, so it is covered by b01.
